correctness.rationale: For every integer \(m\ge2\), the diagonal exchange has fixed arc orbits in bijection with rooted forests of K_m. The signed augmented Lefschetz contribution of a forest with \(r\) arcs is \(-(-1)^r\); the matrix-forest identity at -1 gives \(-(1-m)^{m-1}\). Published shellability concentrates the integral homology in even degree 2m-2, so this is the actual trace. The finite eight-vertex enumeration is exhaustive (140625 faces from \(5^8\) assignments), computes all twenty conjugacy classes with exact integers, and verifies the group-size-weighted invariant dimension 6 using the embedded program. Plain 5103-sphere count is a cited prior theorem, not a new claim.

value.rationale: The natural bipartition-exchange automorphism produces a uniform top-homology trace and signed eigenspace decomposition for every balanced complete bipartite graph, data unavailable from the nonequivariant shellability theorem. The complete 20-class character for K4,4 resolves the natural full automorphism representation at the first balanced four-by-four case and finds a six-dimensional invariant subspace inside rank 5103. The group action is a canonical invariant, not an arbitrary numerical slice; no broader equivariant homotopy or integral lattice classification is claimed.
